messages:
sara.k: deploy-bot just reported packaging job #472 completed but flagged a cosign key mismatch on the airgap bundle. can someone confirm whether we rotated the signing key this morning?

deploy-bot: Packaging job 472 finished. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-private-releases/2026-03-20/airgap-bundle-v1.5.0.tar.gz. signature verified: FAILED (cosign key id mismatch).

devin_packaging: looking now — i started a key rotation script at 02:10UTC for the onboarding key. i forgot to update the release pipeline for builds using the new key. my bad.

priya_r: ok — that explains the mismatch. customers pulling the airgap bundle will fail verify if we push this signed bundle. what's our preferred action: update pipeline and repackage (rollforward) or revert to last known-good signed bundle (rollback)?

daniel_ops: revert to last known-good is fastest to reduce customer impact. we can publish a patch note that the v1.4.9 signed bundle is available for stable installs and mark v1.5.0 as "do not use" until re-signed.

jenna_sre: agree on rollback to minimize risk, but we need to confirm no DB migration or schema ties in v1.5.0. any migrations in that release?

devin_packaging: no schema migrations — v1.5.0 is packaging fixes + TLS fixes for private installs. safe to revert.

priya_r: steps i suggest: 1) mark v1.5.0 artifacts as quarantined (don't expose to public bucket) 2) republish v1.4.9 signed bundle to releases path 3) update release notes and change window 4) schedule a re-sign + rebuild during next change window once pipeline uses new key. sound ok?

daniel_ops: that's fine. i'll handle the S3 flags and make sure the CDN origin does not serve the quarantined objects.

buildbot: Action queued: copy s3://redwood-private-releases/staging/v1.4.9/airgap-bundle.tar.gz -> s3://redwood-private-releases/2026-03-20/airgap-bundle-v1.4.9.tar.gz (checksum and cosign verify).

deploy-bot: COPY step complete. cosign verify: OK. checksum: 6f3a2b4c.

pri ya_r: (typo) priya_r: nice — daniel, can you also add a note to the release channel and update the private release page to flag the quarantine? i'll prepare a short bullet for release notes: "Temporary hold on v1.5.0 airgap due to signing key rotation; v1.4.9 is providing stable installable artifacts. Rebuild and re-sign planned for 03/21 during change window."

jenna_sre: pinging support docs to add a short FAQ entry about verifying cosign signatures locally: put this snippet in the docs: 

```
# verify with cosign public key provided via customer portal
cosign verify-blob --key cosign.pub airgap-bundle-v1.4.9.tar.gz.sig airgap-bundle-v1.4.9.tar.gz
```

sara.k: who will re-run the pipeline to produce v1.5.0 with the new key once devin fixes the pipeline? and how long to repackage?

devin_packaging: estimate 35-45 minutes once the key is swapped in the build secrets and the signing step is using the right key id. i'll do it in the 03/21 change window. i'll also add an automated preflight step to verify signed artifact against expected key id to prevent this class of error.

daniel_ops: make sure we update the dedicated customers list who get pushed images directly. they need the new cosign public key in their vaults or they will fail verification after rotation. i'll produce a short migration checklist: distribute new key, verify signature, update artifact pointers.

priya_r: and confirm rollback playbook steps in runbook: 
- mark artifact quarantined
- restore previous signed artifact to public path
- notify customers + support
- open incident if any customer reports failed installs

jenna_sre: add monitoring alert: cosign verify failures > 5 in 10m on release-bucket -> page oncall. we had a few noisy errors already, want immediate visibility next time.

sara.k: fine — daniel please push the release note and set the "do not use" tag on v1.5.0. devin, follow up here once you have the pipeline fix merged and we'll schedule the re-sign. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

daniel_ops: done — release note updated, v1.5.0 quarantined, support notified. ticket #IR-1287 created for customer notifications.

devin_packaging: merged fix to pipeline, added preflight check. i'll run a dry-run later today and then re-sign in the 03/21 window.

deploy-bot: Notice: scheduled rebuild for v1.5.0 re-sign at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. artifacts will be staged to staging bucket for verification before public publish.

sara.k: closing this thread — keep me posted if anything changes.
